title: 姓名与地址的拼写
goal: 按口头拼读记录字母串，并准确还原姓名、门牌、街名与邮编。

points.label: 按口头拼读记录字母串
还原姓名和地址中的拼写

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力课的内容、知识点与教学规格

body.p: 姓名和街道名按听到的拼读逐个记录字母，不换成熟悉的拼法。double 表示同一个字母连续写两次。把整个名称再拼读一遍是核实，名称只写一次。

body.box: It's Hill: H, I, double L. I'll repeat that: H, I, L, L. → Hill

body.p: 字母、数字和它们的先后顺序都是答案的一部分。门牌、街名、街道类型和邮编分开记录。更正只改被提到的那一部分，其余部分不变。

body.box: It's 18 Fern Road, not Fern Lane. The number is still 18. → 18 Fern Road

cards.title: 字母读音
rows: A / E / I
字母名分别读 /eɪ/、/iː/、/aɪ/，与单词中的元音不同。
A as in apple; E as in egg; I as in ink.
B / P / V
开头的辅音不同。听不清时以后面的解释词为准。
B as in book; P as in pen; V as in van.
G / J
G 读 /dʒiː/，J 读 /dʒeɪ/，区别在末尾的元音。
G as in gate; J as in jam.
M / N
区别在末尾的鼻音。听不清时以重复或解释词为准。
M as in map; N as in net.
O / zero
字母 O 和数字 0 分开记录，以说话人的说明为准。
The letter O, followed by the digit zero.
double / triple
紧跟其后的那个字母写两次或三次。
double L → LL; triple S → SSS

cards.title: 姓氏、街名与邮编
rows: 姓氏
A: Is that Reed? B: It's Reid: R, E, I, D. The third letter is I.
Reid；同音的姓按拼读写。
姓氏
A: How is Bell spelt? B: B, E, double L. I'll repeat it: B, E, L, L.
Bell；double L 写成 LL，再拼一遍不加字母。
街名
A: Is it Beach Road? B: Beech Road: B, E, E, C, H, then Road.
Beech Road；只改街名的拼法，Road 不变。
街名
A: Could I check Willow Lane? B: W, I, double L, O, W. That's W, I, L, L, O, W.
Willow Lane；LL 在词的中间。
邮编
A: Was that AB14 6PQ? B: AB14 6PT. The final letter is T as in tea.
AB14 6PT；只改末尾的字母。
邮编
A: Please repeat the postcode. B: LS6 2NN. L, S, six, two, double N.
LS6 2NN；数字顺序不变，末尾是 NN。

cards.title: 地址的组成
rows: 姓名
姓氏栏只写姓。
First name: Eva; surname: Bell → Bell
门牌
号码后面的字母也属于门牌。
Number twelve B → 12B
街道类型
Road、Lane、Street 是地址的一部分，按原词写。
18 Fern Road; not 18 Fern Lane
邮编
字母和数字的顺序不变；题面允许时可省去空格。
LS6 2NN → LS6 2NN / LS62NN
缩写
题目允许时可用通行缩写。
Road → Rd / Rd.; Street → St / St.

body.box:
A: The parcel is for Ms Hall at 12B Beech Road.
B: Is Hall spelt H, A, L?
A: H, A, double L. And the street is Beech: B, E, E, C, H, not Beach.
B: Twelve B, Beech Road. What is the postcode?
A: AB14 6PT. The last letter is T as in tea.

Surname: Hall
House number and street: 12B Beech Road
Postcode: AB14 6PT

body.p: Hall 末尾是 LL。Beech 和 Beach 的第二个元音字母不同。12B 的 B 是门牌的一部分，不写进邮编。tea 只用来说明字母 T，不写进地址。
答案用原词，不换成同音的拼法。题面要求完整的街道类型时写 Road；允许缩写时，Rd 和 Rd. 也算对。

lines.text: The badge should show the initials E G.
Was the second letter J?
No, G as in gate. The first is E as in egg.

items.stem: Initials: ___ . Write the TWO letters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 G as in gate 和 The first is E as in egg。第二个字母是 G，不是 J。

lines.text: The parcel code is P V B.
Could that be B V P?
No, P as in pen, V as in van, B as in book.

items.stem: Parcel code: ___ . Write the THREE letters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 P as in pen, V as in van, B as in book，字母按这个顺序写。

lines.text: Please label the box M N N.
Is that two letters?
Three letters: M as in map, followed by double N.

items.stem: Box label: ___ . Write the THREE letters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 M as in map, followed by double N。double N 写成 NN。

lines.text: The access code is the letter O, zero, then I.
Does it begin with two zeroes?
No. The first character is the letter O; only the middle character is a digit.

items.stem: Access code: ___ . Write the THREE characters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 the letter O, zero, then I。第一个是字母 O，只有中间是数字 0。

lines.text: My surname is Dunn. That's D, U, double N.
Dunn, with two Ns. I'll put that on the repair receipt.

items.why: 依据是 double N，Dunn 的末尾是 NN。

lines.text: Deliver the groceries to thirty-one Maple Street.
Maple is M, A, P, L, E, and the number is thirty-one?
That's right. Street, not Road.

items.stem: House number and street: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND A NUMBER; use digits for the house number.
items.why: 依据是 thirty-one Maple Street 和 Street, not Road。门牌写 31，街道类型是 Street。

lines.text: The return address is nine Ash Lane.
Did that start with eight?
Nine. The street is Ash: A, S, H. Lane is written in full on the label.

items.stem: House number and street: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND A NUMBER; use digits and the full street type.
items.why: 依据是 Nine 和 The street is Ash。门牌是 9，不是 8；Lane 写全。

lines.text: The postcode is YO10 3AB.
Is the second character zero?
It's the letter O. The digits after that are one, zero, three, then A and B.

items.stem: Postcode: ___ . Write the letters and digits in order; a space between the two parts is optional.
items.why: 依据是 It's the letter O。第二个字符是字母 O，后面依次是 1、0、3。

lines.text: Hello, I'm calling to arrange collection of a damaged suitcase. The case belongs to me, but it will be waiting at my aunt's house. My surname is Penn, with two Ns.
Thanks. Could the surname be spelt out, and could I have the house number and street for the collection?
It's P, E, double N. The address is twenty-six Birch Lane. Birch is B, I, R, C, H, and Lane is the street type. Please don't use Birch Road, which is nearby.
I've recorded the address. There's a tag field as well. What letters appear on the suitcase tag?
The tag reads E J V. That's E as in egg, J as in jam and V as in van. I sometimes see the middle letter copied as G, but it's definitely J.
And is there a separate collection code?
Yes, M double P. That's the letter M followed by two Ps. The code identifies the collection, while the other letters identify the suitcase.
Thank you. I'll keep those two fields separate on the collection record.

items.stem: Suitcase tag: ___ . Write the THREE letters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 E as in egg, J as in jam and V as in van。中间的字母是 J，不是 G。

items.stem: Collection code: ___ . Write the THREE letters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 the letter M followed by two Ps。先写 M，再写两个 P。
依据是 P, E, double N，末尾是 NN。

items.stem: Collection address: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND A NUMBER; use digits and the full street type.
items.why: 依据是 twenty-six Birch Lane。附近的 Birch Road 是另一条街。

lines.text: Good afternoon. I need to update the delivery address for a box of replacement tiles. The old order has the right customer details, but the box should go to our new workshop.
Of course. Please give the building number and the street name, including whether it's a road or a lane.
It's forty-eight Alder Road. Alder is A, L, D, E, R. The postcode is LS7 4NN, ending with double N. I previously gave LS7 4MN by mistake, so that needs correcting.
I'll replace the postcode. The order also asks for a workshop label and a batch code. Are those different?
They are. The workshop label is B V P: B as in book, V as in van, P as in pen. Please keep that order.
And the batch code?
It's the letter O, zero, and J as in jam. The first character isn't a zero. The label marks the destination shelf, while the batch code identifies the tiles.
I've entered both separately. The delivery note will use the new address and the corrected postcode.

items.stem: Workshop label: ___ . Write the THREE letters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 B as in book, V as in van, P as in pen，字母按这个顺序写。

items.stem: Batch code: ___ . Write the THREE characters without spaces.
items.why: 依据是 the letter O, zero, and J as in jam。首位是字母 O，中间是数字 0。

items.stem: Workshop address: ___ . Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND A NUMBER; use digits for the building number.
items.why: 依据是 forty-eight Alder Road。门牌写 48，Road 也可写作 Rd。

items.stem: Corrected postcode: ___ . Write the letters and digits in order; a space between the two parts is optional.
items.why: 依据是 LS7 4NN, ending with double N。原先给的 4MN 已经更正。
